name: council-skills
description: Multi-perspective deliberation councils for Claude Code. A Director convenes specialist roles, runs them in their own lane, lets a red team attack the synthesis, and preserves dissent instead of averaging it.

plugins.name: cloud-council
plugins.description: Convene a cloud-architecture council: a specialist AWS/Azure/GCP architect produces a multi-pillar design decision stress-tested by a red team. Runs single-cloud design/audit, cloud-selection, and hybrid modes. Grounds reasoning in installed cloud skills, treats live-docs MCP as opt-in.

plugins.name: design-council
plugins.description: Convene a product/engineering design council: a panel of specialist roles (product, PM, architecture, front-end, UX, security, data, go-to-market) each contribute in their own lane, a red team runs a pre-mortem, and the Director synthesises with disagreements surfaced rather than flattened.
